sections.h2: Chimney Hill Home Prices and Market Pace
sections.html:
In the 24 months from November 15, 2024 to November 14, 2026, 126 residential sales closed in Chimney Hill (Virginia Beach, VA) according to REIN MLS records. The median sold price was $336,000, close to the citywide median of $405,000, and homes took a median of 10 days to sell, faster than the citywide median of 15 days. These figures come from closed sales, which show what homes actually sold for rather than asking prices.

The middle half of Chimney Hill sales closed between $259,250 and $373,500, or about $220 per square foot against $240 citywide. Split by year, the median sold price in the most recent 12 months ($340,950, 70 sales) was about 2% higher than in the earlier 12 months ($335,000, 56 sales). The typical home sold right at its list price (median sale-to-list ratio of 100%).

Recent Chimney Hill sales were in ZIP code 23462.

sections.h2: What Stands Out About Chimney Hill
sections.html: 3% of Chimney Hill sales had four or more bedrooms, against 40% citywide. 52% of Chimney Hill homes sold for more than their list price, versus 36% citywide, so competing offers were more common than in the typical neighborhood. 61% of Chimney Hill homes went under contract within 14 days of listing, compared with 49% of Virginia Beach sales overall.

sections.h2: When Chimney Hill Homes Sell and How Far Prices Range
sections.html:
Closings in Chimney Hill were busiest in May (15 sales across the two years) and slowest in January (4 sales). Sold prices ran from $135,000 to $407,500, a spread of 3.0x between the lowest and highest sale. 87% of homes closed at or above list price and 2% closed at least 5% below it.

sections.h2: What Kinds of Homes Sell in Chimney Hill
sections.html:
60% of the sales were detached homes and 40% were attached homes (townhomes or condos). The median home was about 1,445 square feet, with the middle half of sales running from roughly 1,319 to 1,602 square feet. 65% of the homes that sold had 3 bedrooms.

Most homes that sold were built between 1980 and 1986, with a median year built of 1983, so this is mostly homes from the 1970s through the 1990s.
